newsitem.title: JAPAN: SHIN-ETSU UNIT SAYS TO SPEND 50 BLN YEN FOR WAFERS.
newsitem.headline: SHIN-ETSU UNIT SAYS TO SPEND 50 BLN YEN FOR WAFERS.

text.p: Shin-Etsu Handotai Co Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd, said on Friday that it would invest a total of 50 billion yen in the 1997/98 and 1998/99 business years to boost output of silicon wafers.
The unit will invest in its factories in Japan, the United States and Britain, a company official said.
The investment will be made in order to boost output of eight-inch epitaxial wafers, he said.
Demand for this type of wafer is rising as an increasing number of semiconductor makers are producing higher-capacity chips, he said.
